p: Church Street is the main shopping street in Eccles, the Salford town that gave the world the Eccles cake. You can still pick one up locally, and they make a cracking snack with a brew.

The Metrolink tram ends at Eccles, which makes it easy to get to MediaCityUK and Salford Quays, with the Lowry and the Imperial War Museum North across the water. Just outside town, the Barton Swing Aqueduct, which swings the Bridgewater Canal round to let ships pass on the Manchester Ship Canal, is one of the great sights of Victorian engineering, and the Trafford Centre is close by too.
Reel Leisure Eccles is for over-18s only.
